NOTE FOR THE APPROACH: it is a FUND MANAGER — a portfolio of real estate investment funds with outside LP capital and a seven-member board — so decisions run through fund-level governance, not one owner. Clay is a consensus-driven decision maker by his own description and an adjunct real estate professor at Tulane; the entry is intellectual, not transactional. CIO Todd Williams is a second door.
